description: Mirror/scraper hosts treated as tier 3: never key_source, never corroboration. Archive hosts may still appear as provenance links, never as confirming sources. Matching: an entry with a dot matches that host and its subdomains; a bare name matches a full DNS label on any TLD (covers multi-TLD families like blogspot.* without enumerating them). Use distinctive names only. Overlap with TIER3_UGC in config.py is harmless. Extend this list freely; tiering applies automatically.
